title: Why Chip Design AI Benchmarks Must Go Beyond Functional Correctness
content: Demand for custom silicon is rising as physical AI, data centers, automotive systems, and edge devices require architectures optimized for specific workloads, memory bandwidth, latency, and energy efficiency. Delivering these designs requires teams to coordinate heterogeneous compute blocks, complex interconnects, and multiple domains while closing increasingly demanding power, performance, and area (PPA) targets. title: Salience Labs thinks optical switching can break AI’s latency bottleneck
content: As AI inference puts new pressure on data center networks, Salience Labs is betting optical circuit switching can cut latency, boost token throughput and reshape how tomorrow’s GPU clusters connect.

title: MU: Investor update
